title: The Shepherd's Bothy
objective: Find the market takings a bandit carried off to the old bothy on the moor, and get back out alive. Leave by the sheepfold gate when you are ready.

rooms.name: Sheepfold
rooms.description: A ring of dry-stone walls on the open moor, empty of sheep. A squat stone bothy stands against the far wall, smoke leaking from its roof.

features.name: Trampled Gate
features.description: The fold's hurdle gate lies flat in the mud.
features.discovery: Boot prints, one pair, lead from the gate to the bothy door. Whoever came here came alone.

rooms.name: Bothy
rooms.description: A single smoky room with a peat fire in the hearth, a straw pallet and a strongbox kicked open on the floor. A low door leads through to a lean-to at the back.

features.name: Open Strongbox
features.description: A market strongbox, its lock smashed with a stone.
features.discovery: The box still holds the market's takings in gold, and a brooch of enamelled silver tucked in its lid.

features.name: Straw Pallet
features.description: A lumpy straw pallet by the fire.
features.discovery: Sewn into the ticking is a cut sapphire, wrapped in a scrap of wool.

items.name: Market Takings
items.description: Sixty gold pieces in a canvas market bag.

items.name: Enamelled Brooch
items.description: A silver brooch enamelled with a blue heron.

items.name: Pallet Sapphire
items.description: A cut sapphire, deep blue, the size of a fingernail.

items.name: Moor Bandit's Coins
items.description: A small pouch of silver pieces.

rooms.name: Lean-to
rooms.description: A cramped peat store under a sagging roof, stacked with turves and old shepherd's tools.

features.name: Peat Stack
features.description: A head-high stack of dried turves.
features.discovery: Behind the turves the bandit hid a stoppered vial of red liquid and a polished bloodstone.

items.name: Potion of Healing
items.description: A stoppered vial of red liquid that glimmers when shaken.

items.name: Bloodstone
items.description: A dark green stone flecked with red, polished smooth.

passages.description: A few steps across the fold to the bothy's door.
A low door at the back of the bothy.

opponents.name: Moor Bandit
opponents.description: A rain-soaked bandit jumps up from the fire, scimitar in hand, and backs towards the strongbox.

endings.title: Out with the takings
endings.text: You walk back out across the moor with the market's gold and the bandit's hoard.

endings.title: Out of the bothy
endings.text: You walk back out across the moor with nothing to show for it.

endings.title: Fallen at the bothy
endings.text: You fall by the peat fire. Your adventuring ends here.
